description: This file defines several custom exception classes used for error handling within a testing framework, including classes like MsgException, WaitForResponseTimedOutError, DeviceUnresponsiveError, InstrumentationError, AbortError, and ParseError.

classes.name: MsgException
classes.description: A generic exception with an optional message, inheriting from Python's Exception class.

classes.name: WaitForResponseTimedOutError
classes.description: An exception indicating a timeout while waiting for a response after sending a command.

classes.name: DeviceUnresponsiveError
classes.description: An exception indicating that the device did not respond to a command.

classes.name: InstrumentationError
classes.description: An exception indicating failure to run instrumentation.

classes.name: AbortError
classes.description: A fatal error exception, inheriting from MsgException, signaling that program execution should be aborted.

classes.name: ParseError
classes.description: An exception indicating unrecognized XML data format, inheriting from MsgException.

methods.name: __init__(self, msg="")
methods.description: Initializer for MsgException that accepts an optional message string.
